flows.name: signup
flows.objective: Open the signup page. Enter Ada Lovelace as the full name and ada@example.com as the work email, choose the Pro plan, tick the terms checkbox, click Create account, and verify the welcome message says Ada Lovelace is on the Pro plan.

flows.name: signup-terms
flows.objective: Open the signup page. Enter Ada Lovelace as the full name and ada@example.com as the work email and leave the terms checkbox unticked. Verify the Create account button is disabled and no welcome message is shown.
